name: Local Data 10
definition: Contains text fields in the local language.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: The language code conforming to ISO 639-1 that identifies the language in which the fields are expressed in this component.

EncodingFormat.name: Encoding Format
EncodingFormat.definition: Data encoding format for local data.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the financial institution in the local language.

Address.name: Address
Address.definition: Structured postal address in the local language.

AdditionalContact.name: Additional Contact
AdditionalContact.definition: Additional information, in the local language, used to facilitate contact with the financial institution, for instance dispute manager name.
